message.content: Find every place that calls groupby without selecting columns first and propose fixes.

content.text: {"version": "courselens-preview-changes/v1", "changes": [{"file": "slides/Lecture 02.ipynb", "action": "replace", "summary": "Select the columns to add up before grouping.", "target": {"text": "totals = sales.groupby('region').sum()", "before": null, "after": null}, "new_text": "totals = sales.get(['region', 'amount', 'units']).groupby('region').sum()"}, {"file": "assignments/a1/a1.ipynb", "action": "replace", "summary": "Select the numeric columns before averaging.", "target": {"text": "means = scores.groupby('team').mean()", "before": null, "after": null}, "new_text": "means = scores.get(['team', 'score', 'minutes']).groupby('team').mean()"}, {"file": "exams/midterm/midterm.tex", "action": "highlight", "summary": "This exam question relies on grouping every column.", "target": {"text": "scores.groupby('team').mean()", "before": null, "after": null}, "new_text": null}]}
